title: Utility Rate Plan Provider Mix
dataSources: Utility bills (`utility:bill`), utility meter readings (`utility:meter`), utility rate changes (`utility:rate`), household accounts (`household:account`), utility payments (`utility:payment`).
app: Electric, gas, and water bills, smart-meter readings, household-account records, and utility rate-plan changes streamed to Splunk HEC via portals, CSV exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utility:rate
| stats sum(estimated_bill_amount) as total_cost avg(projected_usage_units) as avg_usage count as statements by provider
| sort - total_cost
description: Compares providers or household accounts for utility rate plan in one place.
value: A provider mix view makes it easy to see which account is driving the biggest share of household spend.
implementation: Use one provider or account label across bill, payment, and meter feeds so the mix aligns cleanly.
visualization: Bar chart of total cost by provider.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which providers or accounts drive most of your utility rate plan cost.
